title: dryopteris fragrans f. aquilonaris
intro: Dryopteris fragrans f. aquilonaris, commonly known as a species of fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris fragrans f. aquilonaris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
